```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)

# unique <- readRDS("~/YKim-Linguistics/ykim_korean-analysis/unique_database.rds")
```

```{r}
unique_check <- unique |>
  mutate(
    n_jamo = str_count(Jamo_Cleaned_Unicode, "\\S+") ,  
    n_ipa  = str_count(IPA_Syllable_Unicode, "\\S+")
  ) |>
  mutate(equal_length = n_jamo == n_ipa)

unique_check |>
  filter(equal_length == FALSE)
```


```{r}
unique_2 <- unique |>
  mutate(
    IPA_Syllable_Unicode = str_replace_all(
      IPA_Syllable_Unicode,
      "\\s*,\\s*",
      ""
    )
  )

unique_unicodes <- unique_2 |>
  separate_rows(IPA_Syllable_Unicode, sep = " ") |>
  distinct(IPA_Syllable_Unicode) |>
  arrange(IPA_Syllable_Unicode)

saveRDS(unique_2, file = "unique_database_cleaned_ipa.rds")
saveRDS(unique_unicodes, file = "ipa_list.rds")
```
